applications.title: Satellite-image classification

publication.title: Multitask learning for earth observation data classification with hybrid quantum network
publication.authors: Fan Fan, Yilei Shi, Tobias Guggemos and Xiao Xiang Zhu

classical_comparators.role: best tested classical accuracy on this setting

applications.experimental_scope: Reduced balanced SAT-6 setting: 4200/1200/1200 train/validation/test images; three training runs; 12 qubits.
applications.headline_caveat: Simplified simulator benchmark; large CNNs were reference comparisons under lightweight training settings.
applications.uncertainty: Table 4 reports plus/minus 0.002 for MLTQNN, 0.007 for MLTCNN and 0.013 for DenseNet; these are not local confidence intervals.

upstream.data_access: See paper Section 4.1 and upstream dataLoader.py; exact sampled indices have not been recovered here.

Compare the shared encoder with classical convolution and a tuned pretrained vision baseline.

applications.title: Molecular carcinogenicity screening

publication.title: Performance of Quantum Annealing Machine Learning Classification Models on ADMET Datasets

applications.experimental_scope: Carcinogens_Lagunin endpoint; Table 2 lists 196 training examples, including 42 positives; D-Wave Advantage 4.1.
applications.headline_caveat: The positive endpoint is one of ten ADMET datasets; LightAutoML leads on the other nine.
applications.uncertainty: The Table 1 point estimates alone do not establish significance or scaffold-split generalization.

upstream.data_access: The paper's Code and Data Availability statement names links; their targets and exact split artifacts have not been verified here.

acceptance_checks: Recover source molecules, fingerprints and split IDs before claiming a replication.
Include scaffold-separated testing and PR-AUC for the imbalanced endpoint.
Optimize the identical weak-learner QUBO with classical solvers as well as the annealer.
Save embedding, chain breaks, reads, anneal time, queue time and classical preprocessing costs.

applications.title: Hyperparameter-search resource reduction

publication.title: Distributed hybrid quantum-classical performance prediction for hyperparameter optimization
publication.authors: Eric Wulff, Juan Pablo Garcia Amboage, Marcel Aach and colleagues

applications.experimental_scope: CIFAR-10 CNN hyperparameter search; averages over three seeds; similar target-model performance.
applications.headline_caveat: Epoch counts exclude end-to-end annealer overhead; gains over classical prediction are task dependent and aggregation is a confound.
applications.uncertainty: The paper plots error bars; the catalog transcribes means and does not infer significance.

upstream.data_access: CIFAR-10 setup is in upstream cifar10_tf_methods.py and cifar10_torch_methods.py; original trial histories have not been replayed here.

acceptance_checks: Use identical target-model search spaces, seed schedules and stopping rules.
Fit performance predictors on completed training trials without future-epoch leakage.
Compare an equally sized classical predictor ensemble to control for aggregation.
Report final model quality, total target epochs and end-to-end compute and monetary cost separately.
